description: Example manifest. In Phase 1 the admin pipeline generates this per data source (from the target's information_schema + admin-selected tables). The runtime Lambda reads it as manifest.json. Every tool is a read-only SELECT with named (:param) placeholders only.

tools.name: list_open_workorders
tools.description: List open work orders for a production line.
tools.sql: SELECT id, status, created_at FROM workorders WHERE line = :line AND status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: workorder_by_id
tools.description: Fetch a single work order by id.
tools.sql: SELECT id, line, status, qty, created_at FROM workorders WHERE id = :id
